Explore metrics in an interactive dashboard

Source: R/dashboard.R
npc_dashboard.Rd

Opens a Shiny app for browsing the output of npc_build_metrics(): pick a universe, geography, metric, resource, subsector, year and market, and see the market against the distribution of all markets, over time, against a second metric, and across subsectors. The table tab downloads the selection as CSV.

Usage

npc_dashboard(data = NULL, launch = interactive(), ...)

Arguments

data

Metrics to show. Any of:

  • the long output of npc_build_metrics() (or several, combined with rbind(), for example one per universe), or a list of them;

  • its wide output (format = "wide"), a named list of tables;

  • a folder written with out_dir, or a path to a CSV written there;

  • NULL (default), the bundled cbsa_metrics for 2019.

launch

Start the app. With FALSE, return the app object, for example to deploy it with shiny::runApp() or on a Shiny server.

...

Passed to shiny::runApp().

Value

The Shiny app object, invisibly when launched.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
npc_dashboard()      # bundled 2019 CBSA metrics

f <- npc_build_metrics( 2015:2021, geo = c( "cbsa", "county" ), source = "nccs" )
r <- npc_build_metrics( 2015:2021, geo = c( "cbsa", "county" ), source = "nccs",
                        universe = "registered" )
npc_dashboard( rbind( f, r ) )
} # }
